mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces discount rates for future equity cash flows and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances despite a declining FEDFUNDS trend, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k per month signals strong labor market demand, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances despite PAYEMS > 200.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts below 1.4 million units signals weakening residential demand, which reduces construction activity and consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in fewer than 40% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and a rise in the unemployment rate signal a contraction in manufacturing output and labor market stress, which together indicate an impending economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 102.0 and UNRATE > 3.8 in the prior month
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 60-day returns in fewer than 40% of instances where both INDPRO < 102.0 and UNRATE > 3.8, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above $700 billion signals strong consumer demand, which supports corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances despite RSAFS > 700.0, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 5.0% combined with a decline in CPIAUCSL below 3.0% signals a disinflationary monetary tightening, which reduces inflation expectations and supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 5.0 and CPIAUCSL < 3.0 in the prior month
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in fewer than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.0 and CPIAUCSL < 3.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real GDP growth below 1.0% annualized over the past quarter signals weak aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 < 1.0 (annualized growth rate) in the prior quarter
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in fewer than 40% of instances despite GDPC1 < 1.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% and a decline in non-farm payroll growth below 100k signals labor market deterioration, which reduces consumer spending and corporate hiring, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 4.0 and PAYEMS < 157000.0 (thousands) in the prior month
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 20-day returns in fewer than 40% of instances where UNRATE > 4.0 and PAYEMS < 157000.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.
